scripts.format: turbo run format && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format:check: turbo run format:check && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint: turbo run lint && uv run ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: turbo run typecheck && uv run mypy .
scripts.test: turbo run test && uv run pytest
scripts.validate: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
